title: video.yaml
description: The source of truth of one video bundle. references/video-bundle.md documents every field.

title.description: The video's title, for the bundle's README and the report. Never shown or spoken unless a slide says it.

slug.description: Kebab-case name. The finished video is build/<slug>.mp4.

date_stamp.description: The date shown in the lower right corner of the title slide, YYYY.MM.DD, or false for none. new writes the bundle's creation date; without the key, the date comes from a YYYY-MM-DD- folder name.

guidance.description: Video-wide guidance, applied on every rebuild of every scene. Never shown or spoken.

brief.description: What the opening and closing are written from (references/structure.md). Every field is optional. Never shown or spoken as written.

outcome.description: What a viewer can do or knows after watching. The opening is written from it.

takeaways.description: At most three points the closing restates in new words.

action.description: The one thing a viewer should do next. The closing asks for it, and the end card shows it.

references.description: Documents to cite. The end card shows each by name; the deck links each that has a url.

name.description: The short name the end card shows.

url.description: Where the reference lives. Linked in the deck, listed in the report, never shown as text on a slide.

provider.description: Who voices the narration. Wins over [video] provider in .ai-skills.toml; the default is polly.

voice.description: Amazon Polly voice ID, such as Stephen. Wins over [video.polly] voice.

engine.description: Amazon Polly engine: generative, long-form, neural or standard. Wins over [video.polly] engine.

id.description: ElevenLabs voice ID. Wins over [video.elevenlabs] voice_id.

model.description: ElevenLabs model ID. Wins over [video.elevenlabs] model.

settings.description: ElevenLabs voice_settings, sent as given: stability, similarity_boost, style, use_speaker_boost, speed.

id.description: Deprecated: voice.elevenlabs.id. Read as the ElevenLabs voice ID.

model.description: Deprecated: voice.elevenlabs.model. Read as the ElevenLabs model ID.

settings.description: Deprecated: voice.elevenlabs.settings. Read as the ElevenLabs voice_settings.

say_as.description: Written form to spoken form. Applied to narration before voicing; the slide keeps the written form.

lead_in.description: Seconds between a slide appearing and its narration starting.

tail.description: Seconds a slide stays after its narration ends, before the next scene.

gap.description: Seconds between one live step's line ending and the next step's line starting.

fade_out.description: Seconds the finished video fades to black and silence at its end, never over its last spoken line. 0 turns it off.

browser.description: Playwright new_context options by their Python names, plus launch (launch options) and file (a .yaml or .json file of the same options). Recorder-owned keys are rejected.

id.description: Stable ID. The slide that shows this scene carries data-scene="<id>".

source.description: What draws the scene: slide (a slide of the deck), live (a web application) or archify (an animated Archify diagram).

narration.description: Slide and Archify scenes: exactly what the voice says, before say_as. Empty means a silent scene, which needs hold. Live scenes speak their steps' say lines instead.

url.description: Live scenes: the start URL, opened before the first step.

auth.description: Live scenes: the saved sign-in to open with, by profile name (video_cli.py auth). Never its contents.

signed_in.description: Live scenes: a Playwright selector only a signed-in page shows. Its absence means the sign-in has expired.

steps.description: Live scenes: what happens, in order. Each step's say line plays while its do actions run.

script.description: Live scenes: a Python file in the bundle's scenes/ folder that drives the page instead of the steps' do actions. Its run(page, line) calls line(n) to start step n's say line.

diagram.description: Archify scenes: the diagram, as Archify JSON in the bundle's diagrams/ folder. Its diagram_type is architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle, erd, tree, class, timeline or waterfall.

theme.description: Archify scenes: the diagram's colour theme.

hold.description: Extra seconds the scene stays on screen after its narration and tail.

chapter.description: The scene's chapter label in DESCRIPTION.md. Consecutive scenes with the same label are one chapter. Leave it out to label the scene from its id. Never shown or spoken.

steering.description: A one-off change for the next rebuild. Applied once, then moved to history.md.

guidance.description: A standing rule for this scene, applied on every rebuild. Never shown or spoken.

say.description: What the voice says while this step's actions run, before say_as. Empty means a silent step.

do.description: Actions, in order. Ignored when the scene has a script.

action.description: One action, as a single key: goto, click, hover, fill, type, press, scroll or wait.

goto.description: A URL, resolved against the scene's url.

click.description: A selector. The target is outlined for 300 ms before the click.

type.description: Types the text visibly, key by key.
